data.name: The Aloha Bakery
data.detailed_description:
Buzz


About the Game

“Aloha Bakery” is a 3D platforming, point and click adventure, cooking and crafting game and visual novel dating sim. A unique combination, we know, but we assure you, a most entertaining one. Play as Bostonian chef Brian Maturin as he visits his brother-in-law in the beautiful resort town of Kuhonu, Hawaii. During his time in the sunny island he will make new friends, cook for some cool restaurants and will meet the love of his life! The only question is, who will it be?

 

Featuring

 

  • Fun platforming to find key ingredients!

  • Crafting mechanics to create the right dishes for the right restaurants.

  • A romantic plot with affection meters depending on which dishes you make for whom!

  • A fun and varied contemporary soundtrack

  • Beautiful anime sprites by Rosuuri and Bill Phan

  • A chill and tropical town for you to enjoy and explore!

  • Point and click puzzle mechanics for the rarest recipes and dishes

  • Multiple Endings

  • Early branching story (lots of replay value)

Writer/Director

Antonio Lorenzo Carino

Composer

Antonio Lorenzo Carino

Programmer

Carlo Antonio

Character and CG Artist

Rosurri

Additional Art Sprites

Bill Phan

UI and Icon Art

Hyeon-Seok Yu

"Sun and Sand" performed by Rubaiyat Howlader

Make friends, cook for top restaurants, and find the love of your life in this sunny island paradise! Who will it be?
